messages.subject: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi Jules and Robin, your van-travel videos look like a natural setting for portable charging. I am Mira, working with VOLTLEAF. Would you be interested in a YouTube integration or pre/mid-roll? Timing is flexible. We can also discuss sending a product to try before deciding on a paid collaboration. Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi Mira, we would be interested in hearing more. Our current media kit is attached. Thanks, Jules and Robin, Field Paws

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Thanks for sending your media kit and rates. I will discuss them with the VOLTLEAF team and come back to you. Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi Jules and Robin, would three YouTube integrations for a total of £1,800 work for you? This would be £600 per integration, with each payment made separately after the corresponding video is published. Please let me know what you think of this VOLTLEAF proposal. Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi both, following up on the three-integration VOLTLEAF package below. Is that scope and fee workable for you? Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Just checking whether you have had a chance to review the VOLTLEAF offer. Happy to hear your feedback. Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi Jules and Robin, I am introducing my colleague Leon, who has a separate camera-brand opportunity for you. I will continue handling VOLTLEAF; Leon will handle the camera opportunity. He will share the details here. Best, Mira

messages.subject: Re: VOLTLEAF x Field Paws — YouTube collaboration
messages.body: Hi Jules and Robin, nice to meet you. I work with LENSNEST on a camera campaign. Could we discuss £600 for a 2–3 minute YouTube integration plus a short clip cross-posted to your social channels? The proposal includes two months of content usage, an 8% affiliate commission and keeping the product. Looking forward to your thoughts. Best, Leon
